items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I got a nice offer to go down and play with them and I left Dave Payton and went to the plantation with Joe.

ctx.x: Thank God. You were here. You were dressed again. You had two jobs. You played with Elgar and then...
Got off at quarter of 12. You left Elgar at quarter of 12? Uh-huh. Went home and chained my clothes and started this job at 1.30, and Joe Oliver started his job at 1.30.
I did quite... I didn't get that straight.
This is not the same dude band where King Oliver plays.

No. No. That's on the south side. Yeah. Well, see? Now, I'm glad you brought that up. I came out there with my band. Get this, my band. You hear this? Yes. I think I told you this before. Tell me again. And when King Oliver finishes and goes down to the Pekin, I come out there with my band with a trumpet. Me.
